# Atlas UI: round 3, the Chokepoint Watch (draft, UI agent)

Builds on `.scratch/atlas-ui/spec.md` (rounds 1 and 2). It adds surfaces for the board, the Watch memo and the bear checks. It reuses rounds 1 and 2's tokens, `<Status>`, `<Quote>`, `<RecordsFold>`, the row-as-link, the `.step` / `.step-details` disclosure, the date helpers and the leak guard. It needs no new npm dependency and no new colour token.

**Hard rule for this round: the shipping state is empty.** 0.6.17 goes live with no chokepoint and no watch run, so every new slot renders nothing. On production, Today stays at 999/1542 px or less (desktop/phone) and Theme photonics at 1722/2904 px or less. That is an acceptance check (§7).

---

## 0. Decisions this round forces

| # | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | **The memo gets its own `Watch` section on Today, keyed by theme slug. It does not sit inside a theme card.** | `POST /watch-runs` does not check the theme against the universe (confirmed in `chokepoints/service.py`), and robotics may be missing from `GET /themes`. One code path then works in both cases. The cards keep their height. |
| R2 | **The full memo lives on its own page, `/watch-run/?id=`.** The theme page shows only its first paragraph and a link. | A memo is long, written by the agent, and not evidence. It should not lengthen the theme page. |
| R3 | **On a theme with a thesis, the board sits after the step rows** and before Changed \| Due. **On a board-only theme, the board leads.** | The assessment comes first, then its argument, then discovery. The board never goes between the thesis block and its steps. The watch spec's "the theme page leads with the board" holds where there is no thesis. |
| R4 | **A theme with nothing to say has no card on Today.** "Nothing" means no company, no active Belief, no chokepoint and no watch run. A theme with only a board or a run gets a one-line card. | If robotics joins `GET /themes` at 0.6.17, today's code would render a full card reading "Starting · 0 of 0 companies have documents · N layers without a company". That card would be wrong and would make Today taller. |
| R5 | **`/theme?id=<slug>` no longer fails** for a slug that is missing from `GET /themes` when the board or the watch runs have items. It renders the board-only layout instead (§2.3). | Today's guard (`summary === undefined` → "it is not one of the themes") runs before `Body`. Robotics would hit it. |
| R6 | **Board rows fetch no Fact.** They count `evidence.fact_ids` only. Only `/chokepoint` fetches Facts (`GET /facts/{id}`, at most 24 on load), and the rest load when their step opens. | There is no batch route. A board of 10 rows must stay a single request. |
| R7 | **A Fact's span link is `routes.span(fact.assertion.source_version_id, fact.id)`**, because a Fact's id is its Assertion's id. New components never read `span_start` or `span_end`. | The secondary source scan forbids those fields outside an href. |
| R8 | **A holder links only when it has a slug that `GET /companies` resolves to a company id.** Otherwise its name is plain text and never a dead link. The CIK goes in Records. | `Holder` has `slug`, but pages take `id`. `Company` has both `id` and `slug` (checked in `schema.ts`). |
| R9 | **The memo renders into React elements, with no `innerHTML` anywhere.** Links are http(s) only. Fenced code is dropped and inline code becomes plain text. | The memo is untrusted and is shown on Today. |
| R10 | **The memo is not excluded from the leak guard.** Quotes are excluded because they are the document's words. The memo is Atlas's own words, so it is held to the owner's rules. The W2 prompt carries them (ticket B9), and a seeded "dirty" memo proves the renderer neutralises what it can. | |
| R11 | **The steps' for/against shape matches the Hypothesis page:** Constraint, Demand against supply, Control, Capture, then `Against`: Relief and the invalidation step. Region names come from `STEPS` (`lib/beliefs`); compact labels come from `STEP_LABELS` (`lib/argument`). Step letters never show. | One argument shape across Atlas. |
| R12 | **Chokepoint and bear-check vocabularies go in `lib/status.ts`**, so the round-1 enum-coverage test covers them. Logic goes in new pure modules. | Y3. |

---

## 1. Today

### 1.1 Where the memo sits

There is a new section between the theme cards and the Agents line. It is an `<section aria-labelledby="watch">` with the h2 `Watch` (`.reader-label`). It holds one row per theme that has a watch run or a chokepoint. Rows follow the cards' theme order, then any watch-only slugs alphabetically.

```
WATCH
● Robotics · 24 Oct · Weekly                          4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready
  Two makers hold most precision reducer capacity; lead times stretched again in two
  filings this week. Nothing ruled out.
  Read the memo →
```

**Line 1:**
- An unseen dot, when the run's `created_at` is after the last-visit mark. It uses `isUnseen` from `lib/seen`.
- The theme title. It comes from `GET /themes`, or is the humanised slug (`robotics` → `Robotics`, `memory-packaging` → `Memory packaging`).
- `plainDay(run_date)` and the mode word: `Weekly`, or `First survey` for an `architect` run.
- **Right side:** the board line, `4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready · 1 needs a second look`. Zero counts drop out, and the line links to `/theme?id=<slug>#board`.

**Line 2:** `memoExcerpt(memo)`, the first paragraph as plain text. It falls back to the first list's items joined with ` · `, never a heading. It is 0.95rem `--text-2` with a 2-line clamp.

**Line 3:** `Read the memo →`, linking to `/watch-run/?id=`.

**Behaviour:**
- The row is a `.reader-row`. Its title link (theme · date · mode) carries the overlay to the memo page, and the board link sits above the overlay as `.row-secondary`.
- With no run in 9 days, line 1 adds `no run this week`, in warn. The Watch is weekly, so this catches a CronJob that stopped.
- A theme with chokepoints but no run gets line 1 without a date or mode (`Robotics · 4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready`), and no lines 2 or 3.

### 1.2 What shows with no memo and no board

Nothing renders: no heading and no skeleton. That is the shipping state. While loading, the section also renders nothing, so its arrival shifts only the Agents and Record lines below it. The cards above load slower.

A failed read hides the row and shows no error. Today's slot rule still holds: a failure costs only its own slot.

### 1.3 Theme cards

**A card is hidden** when its theme has `company_count == 0`, no active Belief, no chokepoint and no run (R4). On Themes it still shows, as `Robotics · Not started`.

**A watch-only card** has a theme in `GET /themes`, chokepoints or a run, and no active Belief. Line 1 is the title plus `<Status>` `Watching` (muted). Line 2 is the one line `4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready · last watch 24 Oct`. There is no strip and no Changed or Due.

**A card with Beliefs** gets no new line. The board count appears only in the Watch row, never twice.

**Layer names:** `startingLine`, `startingStatus` and `LayerMatrix` use `layerName(layer)`. It returns `COMPANY_LAYERS[layer]` when the layer is known, else the humanised slug (`gating-equipment` → `Gating equipment`). Today, W6a's free slugs would render `undefined` here.

### 1.4 Both cases for robotics

| | Robotics in `GET /themes` | Robotics not in `GET /themes` |
|---|---|---|
| Before its first run (the shipping state) | No card on Today (R4); `Robotics · Not started` on Themes; Watch section empty | Not visible anywhere |
| After the architect run | A watch-only card plus a Watch row | A Watch row only, which opens `/theme?id=robotics` (board-only, R5); Themes lists it as a watch-only card |

### 1.5 Data, added to Today's parallel loads

- `GET /watch-runs?limit=20`: all themes, newest first. `latestByTheme` keeps one run per theme.
- `GET /chokepoints?limit=500`: counts per theme, via `boardCounts`. No Fact is fetched (R6).

Both return `items: []` in the shipping state.

### 1.6 Phone (390)

- Line 1 wraps: the title and date on one line, the board line under it at 0.85rem.
- Line 2 keeps its 2-line clamp.
- One row is about 110px. The section has no fixed height.

---

## 2. Theme page

### 2.1 A theme with both a thesis and a board (photonics, later)

The order is round 2's, plus one section:

1. Crumb, h1
2. Thesis block (unchanged)
3. `What Atlas believes`, the step rows (unchanged)
4. **`Chokepoints`** (new; `id="board"`, `aria-labelledby`), rendered only when the board has items or a run exists
5. Changed \| Due
6. Companies
7. Records

In the shipping state, item 4 renders nothing, so photonics keeps its 1722/2904 px.

### 2.2 The board section

```
CHOKEPOINTS
Watch · 24 Oct · Weekly · Read the memo →
● primary source  ○ lead only  ✕ contradicted  – not examined

THESIS-READY (1)
Indium phosphide substrate capacity                                  Thesis-ready
AXT, Sumitomo Electric +1 · Substrate · Not yet noticed · relief 2028
Constraint ● Demand ● Control ● Capture ○ · Against Relief – Invalidation –

CANDIDATES (2)
...
LEADS (5)
...  (first 5, then "All 9 leads" expands in place)

▸ Ruled out (3)
```

**Header:**
- The memo line: the theme's latest run as `Watch · <plainDay> · <mode word> · Read the memo →`. With no run, it is omitted.
- The key, one muted 0.8rem line, `aria-hidden` (each pip carries its own name).

**Groups,** in this order, each with a `.reader-label` h3 and its count:
1. `Thesis-ready`: rows needing a second look come first, then the latest event first.
2. `Candidates`
3. `Leads`: the first 5, then `All N leads`.

An empty group renders nothing.

**`Ruled out (n)`:** a closed `<details className="board-killed">` whose rows render only on first open, like `RecordsFold`. Each row reads `constraint · ruled out 3 Nov · <status_reason, 1-line clamp>`. It is not inside Records: a ruled-out bottleneck is an assessment (Atlas looked and said no), so it stays one click away.

**One row per chokepoint** (`components/chokepoint-row.tsx`, `<li className="reader-row">`):
- **Line 1:** the constraint (`.row-title`, the link to `/chokepoint/?id=`, 2-line clamp). On the right, the status word plus badges:
  - `Needs a second look` (warn) when `needs_review`.
  - `Quiet since 14 Aug` (warn) when `stale`. The date is `last_evidence_at`, in `plainDay` form.
- **Line 2** (`.row-secondary`, 0.85rem muted), from these parts, each omitted when absent:
  - Holders: up to 2 names, then `+N`. A name links to its company only by R8.
  - `layerName(layer)`.
  - The crowding word.
  - `relief <horizon>`, clamped to 24 characters.
- **Line 3:** `<StepPips>`, a `<ul aria-label="Steps">` in the Hypothesis order:
  - Four for-pips, a `·`, the small word `Against`, then two pips.
  - Each `<li>` reads `Label mark`, with the accessible name `Control: lead only`.
  - Marks: `●` primary source (`--text-2`), `○` lead only (`--text-2`), `✕` contradicted (`--gap`), `–` not examined (`--muted`).
  - As in Y1, colour means state and never side. Only contradicted takes colour.

A row shows no holder CIKs, no event counts and no ids.

**Phone:**
- Line 1 wraps, with the status word under the title.
- Line 2 wraps.
- The pips wrap to two lines: the four for-pips, then `Against` and its two. That matches the ArgumentStrip's 4 + 2.
- A row is about 100px.

### 2.3 A board-only theme (robotics)

The code path (R5):
1. `Theme()` loads `GET /themes`.
2. When `summary === undefined`, or when the summary has no company and no Belief, it loads `GET /chokepoints?theme=<slug>&limit=500` and `GET /watch-runs?theme=<slug>&limit=8` by slug.
3. If either has items, it renders `<WatchBody slug summary?>`.
4. Otherwise it keeps today's error, or today's starting block for a theme in the list.

**Layout:**
1. Crumb `Themes`; h1 the theme title (from the summary, else the humanised slug).
2. The status line: `Watching · last watch 24 Oct · Weekly · 2 runs · 4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready`.
3. `This week's memo`: the latest run's excerpt, the first paragraph (3-line clamp, `.measure`), then `Read the memo →`.
4. The board (§2.2), here as the page's lead section.
5. `Open Issues`: the existing `<OpenIssues theme>` (7 rows plus `All Issues`). These hold the architect run's decomposition of the industry. They are questions, not evidence.
6. `Companies`, only when the theme is in `GET /themes` and has companies (the layer matrix). Otherwise it is omitted, with no "no company" filler.
7. `<RecordsFold counts="2 watch runs">`, with:
   - every watch run as a row (`date · mode word · tool calls · cost`), each linking to its memo page;
   - when the theme is in `GET /themes`, the theme description and the universe details.

**Empty board with a run:** the board section reads `Nothing on the board yet.` in one muted line, and the memo still shows.

**Phone:** the same order, Records closed.

### 2.4 Theme page states

- **Board read fails:** the section shows `Chokepoints unavailable` in one muted line, or nothing on a theme with a thesis (where the board is secondary).
- **Loading:** the board makes no skeleton on a thesis theme, which keeps the shipping height. A board-only theme shows the round-1 thesis-block skeleton.

---

## 3. Chokepoint page (`/chokepoint/?id=`, `app/chokepoint/page.tsx`)

**Job.** What the scarce thing is, who holds it, how far the evidence has got, what it still needs, what would kill it, and the quotes, two clicks from the board.

**Layout, top to bottom:**

1. **Crumb:** the theme title, linking to `/theme?id=<slug>#board`.

2. **Kicker:** `Robotics · Gating equipment` (the theme, then `layerName`). **`<h1>`:** the constraint.

3. **Holders:** `Held by Harmonic Drive Systems, Nabtesco, Leaderdrive`.
   - Each name follows R8: linked when it resolves to a company, else plain text.
   - A name outside the research gets a muted `not yet researched` after it, only on this page.
   - With no holders: `Holder not yet named` (warn).

4. **Verdict line:** `<Status>` word, then the reason and date.
   - `Candidate · since 12 Oct`
   - `Thesis-ready · since 20 Oct`
   - `Ruled out 3 Nov: <status_reason>` (`--gap`). The reason is the backend-written words, shown whole.
   - `Lead · since 12 Oct`. The date is the last `status_set` event's `at`, else `created_at`.
   - Badges after the word: `Needs a second look` and `Quiet since 14 Aug`, as on the board.

5. **What it still needs**, one line, omitted when the gate holds and the status is thesis-ready, and omitted when ruled out:
   - `Still needs: a primary source for demand against supply · a kill criterion · an open question`.
   - For `needs_review`, it reads `No longer thesis-ready: it needs a primary source for control again`.
   - **Gate holds but not yet thesis-ready:** `Meets the bar for a thesis: Constraint, Demand and Control quoted, a kill criterion and an open question.`
   - **Thesis-ready and holding:** one muted line, `Next: prove it as Beliefs.`

6. **The argument** (h2 `The argument`, region name kept for the e2e). Six step sections in Hypothesis order, each a `<section aria-label={STEPS[name]}>` with the round-1 `.step-details` disclosure. Against-steps carry `Against the thesis` in their summary.

   **The summary:** the step name; the step-status word (`<Status>`); a count line `2 quotes · 1 lead · 1 open question` (zero parts dropped); `set 12 Oct` from `set_at`; and, when Facts are loaded, the first Fact's statement as the headline (2-line clamp).

   **An unexamined step** renders as a plain row, `Relief · Not yet examined`, with no disclosure, like round 1's empty step.

   **The body, when opened:**
   - Facts as `<Quote>`s (statement, verbatim quote, caption, `Open in source →` through R7). The caption is the company name (`subject_company_id` via the companies map) · the document (from `GET /source-versions/{id}`, one read per distinct version, cached) · `evidenceDay(available_at)`. `against` is set for a contradicted step.
   - Issues as row-links to `/issue?id=`, titled from the `GET /issues` list Atlas already caches (`key "issues"`).
   - Leads: `2 leads` in muted text, unlinked until B6. There is no `GET /leads/{id}`, and a dead or wrong link is worse than a count.

   **Fetching:** on mount, the first 24 distinct `fact_ids` across the steps load in parallel. A step whose Facts were not loaded fetches them when it opens and shows `+N quotes loading`. A Fact that fails shows `Quote unavailable` in its place.

   **Two clicks:** board row → `/chokepoint` (click 1); open the step (a disclosure, which does not count, as in round 1, §8.9); `Open in source` (click 2).

7. **A band of three columns at ≥ 64rem**, stacked below that:
   - **`What would kill it`:** the kill criteria as a list. With none, `None written yet` in warn, since the gate needs one.
   - **`When supply could catch up`:** `relief_horizon.horizon` in body text, then `basis` as one `--text-2` paragraph. With none, `Not estimated`, muted.
   - **`Context, not evidence`:** the crowding word, with one muted sentence: `How much the market already sees it. Never used as evidence.` With no crowding, `Crowding not judged`.

8. **`Open questions`:** the linked Issues still open, as rows. The closed ones go to Records.

9. **`<RecordsFold counts="14 events">`:**
   - **History**, oldest first. Each event is one sentence from `historyRows(events)`, a replay that knows each value before and after:
     - `24 Oct · Created at Gating equipment, held by 3`
     - `Control: not examined → lead only · why: <reason>`
     - `Status: Candidate → Thesis-ready`
     - `Kill criteria rewritten (2)`
     - `Note: <text>`
     
     Each sentence is followed by `· by <actor>` and a `session` link. `exact` timestamps are allowed here only.
   - The holders' CIKs.
   - The closed linked Issues.
   - The created-by session or run.

**States:**
- **Loading:** an h1 skeleton and six step outlines.
- **Not found:** `This chokepoint does not exist.`
- **Error:** `Could not load the chokepoint`.

**Phone:** the same order. The band stacks. The verdict line wraps, with the badges under the word.

---

## 4. Company page: the bear checks

**Where:** a section after `What Atlas believes` and before `On this company`: `<section aria-labelledby="bear">` with the h2 `Bear checks`. They are mechanical, so they follow Atlas's assessment and come before the calendar and the documents.

**The summary line:** `1 flag · 4 clear · 1 unknown`. Then a grid of six cells: 3 columns at ≥ 40rem, 2 on a phone. Each cell is a `<details>`.

**The cell's summary** is `label` / `<Status>` word / `value` (0.85rem tabular), for example `Gross margin (GAAP, last 4 quarters) · Clear · 41%`.

**The cell's body:**
- `basis`, the backend-written words, as one `--text-2` paragraph.
- Then its sources:
  - A source span is a `<Quote>` with `Open in source`.
  - A financial observation reads `Shares outstanding 52.1M · 10-Q · 30 Jun 2026`, linking to its Source Version when the observation names one.

**An unknown cell is always shown** and is never collapsed into the others. Its summary reads `Unknown · <basis's first clause>` (e.g. `Unknown · no share counts filed`), so the reason is visible without opening it.

| Key | Label | `value` shown as |
|---|---|---|
| `dilution` | Share count growth | `+12% in 12 months` |
| `shelf_or_atm` | Shelf or at-the-market offering | `S-3 filed 4 Mar 2026` / `none in 12 months` |
| `gaap_gross_margin` | Gross margin (GAAP, last 4 quarters) | `41%` |
| `customer_concentration` | Customer concentration | `one customer 38% of revenue` |
| `going_concern` | Going-concern warning | `none` / `in the 10-K, FY2025` |
| `net_cash` | Net cash or debt | `net cash $412M` / `net debt $1.2B` |

| Status | Word | Tone |
|---|---|---|
| `flag` | Flag | warn |
| `clear` | Clear | muted (the default takes no colour, as in round 1) |
| `unknown` | Unknown | muted |

`value` is untyped until B8. `lib/bear-checks.ts` validates the shape at runtime and formats a number by key (a ratio as %, an amount with groupDigits and B/M). A string shows as given; null shows `—`. A key or status outside the tables is shown with a console warning: the label is its humanised key and the word is `Unknown`.

**Empty or failed:**
- An old backend answers 404, and a failed read hides the section entirely, with no error line.
- A company with no filings gets six `Unknown`s and the summary line `6 unknown`. That is honest, and it is shown.

**Height:** about 170 px at 1440 (two rows of cells) and about 300 px at 390. The company page stays ≤ 2,000 px at 1440.

## 5. Words, modules and components

### 5.1 Owner words (all in `lib/status.ts`)

| Enum | Value | Word | Tone |

| ChokepointStatus | `lead` | Lead | muted |
| | `candidate` | Candidate | muted |
| | `thesis_ready` | Thesis-ready | ok |
| | `killed` | Ruled out | gap |
| derived | `needs_review` | Needs a second look | warn |
| derived | `stale` | Quiet since `<plainDay(last_evidence_at)>` | warn |
| StepState.status | `unexamined` | Not yet examined (pip `–`) | muted |
| | `lead` | Lead only (pip `○`) | muted |
| | `primary` | Primary source (pip `●`) | muted (the word carries it) |
| | `contradicted` | Contradicted (pip `✕`) | gap |
| Crowding | `early` | Not yet noticed | muted |
| | `emerging` | Getting noticed | muted |
| | `consensus` | Widely known | muted |
| | null | Crowding not judged | muted |
| WatchMode | `architect` | First survey | muted |
| | `delta` | Weekly | muted |
| gate `missing` | `step_a_primary` | a primary source for the constraint | — |
| | `step_b_primary` | a primary source for demand against supply | — |
| | `step_d_primary` | a primary source for control | — |
| | `kill_criteria` | a kill criterion | — |
| | `open_issue` | an open question | — |
| | anything else | something else: needs review, plus a console warning (as `gateFailureText`) | — |
| BearStatus | `flag` / `clear` / `unknown` | Flag / Clear / Unknown | warn / muted / muted |

Section and group words: `Watch`, `Chokepoints`, `Thesis-ready`, `Candidates`, `Leads`, `Ruled out`, `The argument`, `Still needs:`, `What would kill it`, `When supply could catch up`, `Context, not evidence`, `Open questions`, `Bear checks`, `This week's memo`, `Read the memo`, `not yet researched`, `Watching`, `Not started`.

**Never shown above Records:**
- step letters (`step a`)
- the enum codes above
- holder CIKs
- event, run and session ids
- tool calls, cost and tokens
- the actor
- the `counts` keys of a run

### 5.2 `frontend/lib/` (pure, each unit-tested)

**`status.ts`** (extended): `CHOKEPOINT_WORDS`, `STEP_STATUS_WORDS`, `STEP_PIPS`, `CROWDING_WORDS`, `WATCH_MODE_WORDS`, `BEAR_STATUS_WORDS`, `BEAR_KEY_LABELS`, `GATE_MISSING`, `gateMissingText(code)`.

**`chokepoints.ts`:**
- `boardGroups(items)` → `{ ready, candidates, leads, killed }`: needs-review first within ready, then the API order (latest event).
- `boardCounts(items)` → per theme `{ total, ready, review }`.
- `boardLine(counts)` → `"4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready"`, or null.
- `pipsOf(chokepoint)` → the six steps in `ARGUMENT_ORDER` with `against` and the word.
- `badges(chokepoint, now)`.
- `stillNeeds(chokepoint)` → the §3 item 5 line, or null.
- `stepCounts(step)` → `"2 quotes · 1 lead"`.
- `factIds(chokepoint, cap)` → deduped, in step order.
- `historyRows(events)` → sentences with before → after.
- `holderView(holders, slugToId)` → `{ name, href | null, researched }`.
- `layerName(layer)`: `COMPANY_LAYERS`, else the humanised slug.
- `themeTitle(slug, themes)`.

**`watch.ts`:**
- `latestByTheme(runs)`.
- `watchRows(themes, runs, counts, now)`: the ordered Today rows, `noRunThisWeek` after 9 days.
- `memoExcerpt(markdown)`.
- `watchedSlugs(themes, runs, board)`.
- `hasNothing(theme, beliefs, counts, runs)` (R4).

**`markdown.ts`:** `parseMarkdown(src): Block[]`.
- **Blocks:** `heading` (levels 1–3 render as h3, 4–6 as h4, since the page owns h1/h2), `paragraph`, `list` (`ordered`; one level deep, deeper items flattened into it).
- **Inlines:** `text`, `em`, `strong`, `link` (href only when it matches `^https?://`; anything else renders as its text).
- **Neutralised:** inline code becomes `text`. Fenced and indented code blocks are dropped. Raw HTML stays literal text, so React escapes it. Bare UUIDs are removed.
- **Behaviour:** CRLF is normalised. Unbalanced emphasis is literal. The parser is linear-time, with no backtracking regex on unbounded input.
- **Tests:** `<script>`, `javascript:` / `data:` / `//host` links, `[a](https://x) [b](javascript:y)`, nested brackets, entity text, `*_mixed_*`, a 50 KB memo under 50 ms, and a heading-only memo (whose excerpt is the empty string, and the row then drops line 2).

**`bear-checks.ts`:** `parseBearChecks(json)` (a runtime guard until B8), `bearSummary(checks)`, `bearValue(check)`, `firstClause(basis)`.

**`nav.ts`:** `/chokepoint` and `/watch-run` → Themes (`unit/nav.test.ts` adds both).

**`api/client.ts`:**
- `chokepoints({ theme?, status? })` (limit 500)
- `chokepoint(id)`
- `watchRuns({ theme?, limit })`
- `watchRun(id)`
- `bearChecks(companyId)` (a raw `send` with the guard, returning null on 404)
- `companySlugs()` (a memoised `slug → id` from `GET /companies`)

### 5.3 Components (`frontend/components/`)

| Component | What it is |
|---|---|
| `watch-section.tsx` → `<WatchSection rows>` | Today's §1.1. Renders null with no rows. |
| `board.tsx` → `<Board items run? lead?>` | The §2.2 header, groups and the lazily rendered `Ruled out` fold. |
| `chokepoint-row.tsx` | One board row. |
| `step-pips.tsx` → `<StepPips steps>` | The words-and-marks strip, with accessible names. |

### 6.1 Seeding through the public routes

`scripts/e2e.py` gains `seed_board(base_url)`. It runs after `running_api(settings)` serves the first database and before Playwright, with `httpx` against the served API.

1. Look up the ids it needs:

2. `POST /api/v1/issues` three times, opening Issues of theme `photonics` for this purpose only. That leaves `issues.spec`'s seeded Issues untouched.
3. `POST /api/v1/sessions` with `{theme: "photonics", question, as_of: now (UTC), seed_company_ids: [lumentum], actor: "e2e-watch"}`.
   - **Why now:** the event routes refuse a session whose as-of time is more than 36 h before now (`not_prospective`).
   - **One session only:** the session is used for the first chokepoint's creation and one event, to cover that path. Every other write goes without `session_id` (it is optional on both write routes). It is closed at the end.

4. **Chokepoint A,** thesis-ready. `POST /chokepoints` with `{theme: "photonics", constraint: "Indium phosphide laser capacity", layer: "laser", holders: [{name: "Lumentum", slug: "lumentum"}, {name: "Outside Holder Co"}], session_id}`. Then events:

This is the route that produces `needs_review`. The step lock (`thesis_ready_step_locked`) covers only steps a, b and d.
6. **Chokepoint C,** a candidate: step f `contradicted` with a Fact, step c `lead` with I3.
7. **Chokepoint D:** `status_set killed` with the reason `Supply added faster than demand.`
8. **Chokepoint E,** a lead only, with no holder (the `Holder not yet named` case).

critique:
# Round 3 review: the Chokepoint Watch draft

## Verdict
The draft is careful about its plumbing, and most of that is right. The problems are in three places: what leads (on the board-only theme the memo is placed above the board, and on Today the Watch row leads with agent prose); words (several terms are reused with a second meaning: "lead", "Needs a second look", and three near-synonyms for falsifiers); and the bear checks section, which is written against a shape the backend does not have.

Checked in the worktree: the bear checks code on origin/ticket/w4-bear-checks; routes.span and app/version/page.tsx (the viewer highlights only by ?assertion=); company/page.tsx:443; pagination (le=500); the fold in chokepoints/model.py; lib/beliefs.STEPS.

## Where the draft is right (keep)
- R1 and R5 (key the Watch by theme slug): the guard runs before Body, so robotics would hit it; one code path is correct.
- R4's diagnosis: startingLine would render "Starting · 0 of 0 companies…", and COMPANY_LAYERS[layer] is undefined for W6a's free slugs; layerName() is the right fix. The rule needs rework (point 6).
- R6 (board rows fetch no Fact).
- R9, R10 and B9 (React elements, no innerHTML, no leak-guard exemption; B9 a must-have).
- Watch below the theme cards on Today (proof ranks above discovery; Y7 holds; the unseen dot carries the news).
- R3 on a theme with a thesis (refinement in point 9).
- Ruled out as its own closed fold, outside Records.
- The kill criteria / relief / crowding band, and "Context, not evidence".
- Stale as a badge from last_evidence_at (tone wrong, point 10).
- The empty-state discipline.

## Critique
1. The bear checks section is written against a shape that does not exist. BearCheck.value is dict | null, never a scalar. basis is written for agents (XBRL, "in the ledger", "the as-of time", ISO dates, unscaled numbers, bracketed XBRL concept names, the rule's text, "form not ingested: Atlas ingests 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K…"), so "Unknown · <firstClause(basis)>" prints internal vocabulary. A source span has no assertion id and the viewer highlights only by ?assertion=. Fix: format value per check from its fields (dilution growth_pct; gaap_gross_margin ttm_margin_pct + change_points; net_cash net_cash + unit; shelf_or_atm filings[]; the other two pinned in B8); write the Unknown reason on the UI side per check; show basis only in the open body as a muted "How it was read" line; push B8 for a summary or unknown_reason; add a ?start=&end= highlight path to the viewer or link "Open the filing" without a highlight.
2. On Today, the memo excerpt leads and the board does not. Line 2 is agent prose with no path to a quote; the draft's §7.2 concedes a five-step path. Fix: line 2 names up to two chokepoints, each linked (Thesis-ready: … · New: …); line 3 the excerpt, one-line clamp, then "Memo →"; "new" from created_at after the previous run; B12 adds status_set_at.
3. The board-only theme puts the memo above the board, and twice; "This week's" is false once a run is old. Fix: cut it; status line "Watching · last watch 24 Oct · 4 chokepoints · 1 thesis-ready" (drop Weekly and 2 runs); the board header's "Memo · 24 Oct →" is the only memo entry.
4. "Lead" means three things (status, step tier, record). Fix: lead for the record only; status lead → Spotted; step primary → Quoted, lead → Unquoted lead, contradicted, unexamined → Not examined; gate text "a quote for …".
5. "Needs a second look" already has a meaning (round 1's flagged Beliefs), and needs_review mostly fires when the linked Issue is completed — progress raising warn on the best rows, the case the e2e seeds. Fix: Gate lapsed (warn) where a thesis step lost its quote or the kill criteria were cleared; muted "No open question" when only open_issue is missing; a backend ticket on the open-Issue gate; reseed B through field_set kill_criteria: []; drop "No longer thesis-ready" next to a verdict reading Thesis-ready.
6. R4 gives robotics a card and a Watch row on Today, both saying the same counts; company_count == 0 stops hiding the card when W6 admits holders. Fix: a card when the theme has active Beliefs, or has neither board nor run and company_count > 0; a board or run but no Belief gets the Watch row only; both robotics cases identical; Themes keeps its card.
7. The theme page's layout depends on a condition, not on the data: a waterfall behind /themes; memory-packaging with a board would never load it; "Research begins when documents arrive" is false for robotics. Fix: load chokepoints and watch-runs by slug always, in parallel; choose the layout from the data (Beliefs → thesis; board or run → board-led; in list → Starting, zero companies "Not started · the first watch has not run"; else error).
8. The step strip is not glanceable (three similar glyphs after full words, a legend needed, a second visual grammar). Fix: label brightness carries the state (Quoted --text ●, Unquoted lead --text-2 ○, Not examined --muted no glyph, Contradicted --gap ✕); mark first; keep 4 + Against + 2; keep one legend line on the board; on desktop put the strip on line 2's right side.
9. Rows repeat their group, counts include the ruled-out, and on photonics a large board pushes Changed | Due down. Fix: badges only on rows; active = not killed; on a thesis theme either a compact board or the board after Changed | Due (the director leans to the second).
10. Warn is overused: Quiet since (leads go quiet in bulk, thesis-ready ones go quiet while being proven), Holder not yet named, None written yet. Fix: those muted, quiet rows sorted to the end; warn for Gate lapsed and Today's stopped watch, worded "last watch 24 Oct".
11. Three near-synonyms for falsifiers. Fix: band "What would falsify it", gate text "a falsifier"; keep step f "What would invalidate it"; drop the sentence under Context, not evidence; "Meets the bar for a thesis."; "Waiting for proof" (muted) or nothing instead of "Next: prove it as Beliefs."
12. Real memos will leak; only the seeded one is tested; inline code keeps tokens; removed UUIDs leave holes; the memo can never link to evidence. Fix: a deterministic owner-words pass from the status.ts tables; collapse the UUID gap; allow atlas:chokepoint/<uuid> as a Link; B9 fixes the memo's shape; expectNoLeaks against production in W2's first-run acceptance.
13. Smaller: R7 should use fact.assertion.id as existing code does; 24 Facts plus source-version reads on mount is over 30 requests on a phone (make B6 a must-have, or fetch only the first Fact of each thesis step, ≤ 3, as the Hypothesis page does); read GET /issues/{id} for titles missing from the cache; GET /watch-runs?limit=20 can miss themes (raise to 200 or read per slug); match holders by slug, else CIK, else exact name before saying "not yet researched"; drop the default mode word Weekly; clamp relief at a word boundary; title the board-only theme's Issue list "Open questions".
14. Phone: the bear checks grid at two columns is ragged; use rows (label, value right-aligned, word only for Flag or Unknown, each a disclosure), two columns at ≥ 64rem, fixed order. With points 8 and 9 a board row is about 80px on a phone.

## Ranked required changes
1. Bear checks (point 1). 2. Today's Watch row leads with named chokepoints; B12 (point 2). 3. The board-only theme leads with the board (point 3). 4. needs_review words and tone; backend ticket; reseed B (point 5). 5. "Lead" means one thing (point 4). 6. R4 rewritten (point 6). 7. Theme layout from data (point 7). 8. Step strip brightness (point 8). 9. No status word on rows; active counts; compact board or board after Changed | Due (point 9). 10. Warn only for a lapsed gate and a stopped watch (point 10). 11. Falsifier vocabulary (point 11). 12. Memo owner-words pass, atlas:chokepoint links, B9 shape, production leak check (point 12). 13. fact.assertion.id; Facts on mount cut or B6 a must-have (point 13).

## Optional
Two-line board rows on desktop; crowding words Early/Emerging/Crowded with a title noting it is a guess; a backend counts route or counts on ThemeSummary; the relief horizon inside the Relief step's summary; researched holders' bear flag count on the chokepoint page; EDGAR links for holder CIKs in Records; memo page h1 "Robotics · 24 Oct"; an e2e case with robotics in GET /themes and empty.
